subsection.title: Target User and Core Problem
subsection.description: - Identify the main target user and the core problem this PoC should address. - Include the user's situation or current consequence when it helps explain the problem. - Mention the current workaround or evidence only when it materially clarifies the problem.

subsection.title: Desired Business Impact
subsection.description: - State the final business impact the target user should gain and why that matters. - Preserve a measurement signal when the user already has one, but do not require a metric to complete the Section. - Do not ask for a solution, screen, starting state, user-action sequence, or demo procedure. - Do not invent business claims or measures the user did not provide or approve.
